$comment: Few-shot pool for the Munk Multiplier draft-reply generator.
Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-05-26-munk-multiplier-v0-design.md §6
Each entry is one past Munk coach-reply hand-curated to span the
four tone registers his real voice uses. The draft cron picks 3
random samples per Claude call as <example> blocks in the system
prompt so generated replies land on-brand.
Curation guidance:
- 20-30 samples total, balanced across tones (~5-8 each)
- Pull from real past form_checks.coach_notes Munk has sent
- Edit lightly if needed to scrub PII; keep the voice intact
- Tag tone honestly — Claude balances picks across registers
- exercise_slug is optional but improves the picker when
drafting a reply for a specific lift
Schema:
- reply_text: the actual reply (5-300 chars, no greetings/sign-off)
- tone: one of encouraging | corrective | terse | playful
- exercise_slug: optional; matches exercises.slug
- notes: optional curator note (what makes this a good sample)
Apply with: npm run seed:voice-samples (after migration 0043).
THIS FILE IS A PLACEHOLDER. The samples below are STUBS to make
the seed script runnable end-to-end. Replace with real Munk replies
before the draft cron is wired up — otherwise the generator will
speak like a generic coaching app instead of like Munk.
